description: This file defines a React component for a login page with a two-step flow: first collecting email to fetch organizations, then allowing the user to select an organization or input one manually, and finally submitting login credentials. It manages state, handles API calls, and performs navigation upon success or error.

classes.name: Organization
classes.description: TypeScript type defining the structure of an organization object with id, optional name, and other key-value pairs.

methods.name: handleFetchOrgs
methods.description: Handles fetching user organizations based on email input, updates state, and transitions to the credentials step.

methods.name: handleLogin
methods.description: Handles the login process, including validation, API call, error handling, and navigation upon success.
